summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Bitwise Trendwise Bitcoin and Treasuries Rotation Strategy ETF (BITC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long btc, short usd currency. The fund is an actively managed fund that seeks capital appreciation by providing front-month CME Bitcoin futures contracts exposure during upward trends and 100% US Treasurys exposure during downward trends. Importantly, the fund does not directly invest in bitcoin or other digital assets. BITC was launched on Mar 20, 2023 and is issued by Bitwise.
